scripts.build: pnpm --filter web build && pnpm --filter functions build
scripts.test:rules: bash scripts/with-java.sh firebase emulators:exec --only firestore,storage --project demo-solid-drive "vitest run --config tests/rules/vitest.config.ts"
scripts.emulators: pnpm --filter functions build && bash scripts/with-java.sh firebase emulators:start --project demo-solid-drive
scripts.emulators:persist: pnpm --filter functions build && bash scripts/with-java.sh firebase emulators:start --project demo-solid-drive --import=.emulator-data --export-on-exit=.emulator-data
